asset_policy: Images and original caption sidecars remain run outputs; do not add raw dataset assets to source commits.
caption_policy: original UTF-8 text bytes preserved; no rewriting or truncation
held_out_scope: connector training only; parent pretraining overlap unknown
limitations: Validation is held out only from connector training; overlap with the PRISM parent pretraining or OmniGen2 pretraining is unknown.
Original captions are retained byte-for-byte. Breed, fine counts, material, exact text, and inferred object use are not independently verified.
Two validation cases contain mathematical text or a navigation screenshot, so these eight examples are diverse diagnostics rather than a natural-image benchmark.
Shoe caption wall placement is uncertain; puppy breed is unverified; mold caption contains additional remediation advice that is not a visual label.
Shirt 00002870 and rug 00003701 source images are RGBA. Current RGB conversion drops transparency and produces a black background; the rug caption describes white background.
Exact pixel and URL/video grouping plus perceptual duplicate screening do not establish absence of all semantic duplicates.
purpose: Original-caption 16-pair connector overfit plus eight disjoint connector-validation diagnostics

quality_review_exclusions.00000104: Diagnostic selection: original caption is uncertain between feces and chocolate; prefer unambiguous recognizable object supervision for the first controlled overfit.
quality_review_exclusions.00000642: Diagnostic selection: text-dominated Twitter screenshot with long exact OCR content; defer to larger mixed-task evaluation.
quality_review_exclusions.00000939: Visual review: the image shows a lizard/reptile; the original caption identifies it as an amphibian.
quality_review_exclusions.00001376: Diagnostic selection: text-dominated permit login screenshot with uncertain verbatim text transcription; defer to larger mixed-task evaluation.
quality_review_exclusions.00001969: Visual review: the image is blank black; the original caption is a white-image loading-failure narrative rather than grounded scene supervision.
quality_review_exclusions.00002426: Visual review: the pictured coin is a Jefferson nickel, while the original caption identifies it as a quarter.

recommended_measurements: Use all 16 train and eight validation examples for separate fixed-noise flow-loss probes before and after training; preserve seed and sampled timestep/noise per example.
Report fixed-prompt image samples at a normal denoising schedule for native OmniGen2, untrained connector and trained connector with matched resolution, seed and prompt.
Use correct versus shuffled captions with fixed target/noise for conditioning sensitivity; lower train loss alone does not establish prompt following or held-out quality.

Parent diagnostics use a generic image-description question without original captions in the model input; report main-object descriptions with qualitative visual review, not exact caption string accuracy.
semantic_identity_limit: unrecorded subjects and semantic duplicates cannot be proven absent
visual_review_scope: Main object/content match by assistant visual inspection before connector training; not full fine-grained caption verification.
